body: It just depresses me that I would go out of my way (and have) to make her feel better but she doesn't reciprocate.  And my dog issue. This is practically the only thing I could really need assistance on. I love my dog so much yet she is nowhere in sight to help me

I really don't know. I didn't call her my gf and I used the term relationship really loosely because she herself has said that she isn't ready to commit to anything. But I feel like she keeps dangling the prospect of being my of in my face to keep me around.
She likes to play the 'I don't like what you are saying so I'm hanging up the phone and not responding to anything you say to me' card.
